🗓️ Your Daily Routine (30-45 min)
Step 1 — Open the Plan tab. Find today's day card. Read the content. (5 min)
Step 2 — Do the BBC/TED listening exercise if the day has one. (6-10 min)
Step 3 — Copy the yellow rehearsal prompt and paste into a new Claude chat. Practice with Claude. (20-25 min)
Step 4 — Come back here and log your KPIs in the dashboard. (2 min)
Step 5 — During commute: listen to Business English Pod or BBC 6 Minute English. (Bonus)

English Radar
🎧 Listening Practice
Train your ear for natural English speed and accents — the most neglected skill in interview preparation.
📻 BBC 6 Minute English
6 minutes · Professional topics · British accent · Transcripts available
💡 Method: Listen once without transcript. Note words you missed. Listen again with transcript. Shadow 3 sentences.
Open BBC →
🍁 Bob the Canadian — Listening
Clear Canadian accent · Natural pace · Vocabulary in context
💡 Method: Watch without subtitles. Pause and repeat sentences that felt fast. Use the search to find topic-specific episodes.
Open Bob →
🎤 TED Talks — Advanced Listening
Native speaker pace · Technical and leadership topics · Interactive transcripts
💡 Method: Watch 10 minutes without subtitles. Score yourself 1–5 on comprehension. Re-watch difficult parts. Note vocabulary.
Open TED →
📱 ELSA Speak — Pronunciation & Listening
AI-powered · Accent training · Phoneme-level feedback · Mobile app
💡 Use for: Identifying your specific pronunciation gaps. 10 minutes per day consistently produces measurable accent improvement.
Open ELSA →
📖 Reading Practice
Build professional vocabulary and reading speed through daily English content in your field.
📰 PMI Today — Professional PM Reading
Industry articles · PM vocabulary in context · Current trends
💡 Method: Read one article per day. Underline 5 words you would use in an interview. Write one sentence using each word.
Open PMI →
🌐 Gulf Business / Arabian Business
Gulf business English · Regional context · Professional vocabulary
💡 Method: Read 2 articles per week about KSA or UAE business. Note how professional decisions and strategies are described in English.
Open Arabian Business →
📱 Grammarly — Writing Quality Checker
Grammar correction · Vocabulary enhancement · Tone analysis
💡 Use for: Paste your Q&A written answers into Grammarly. Review every suggestion — each one is a grammar lesson.
Open Grammarly →
✍️ Writing Practice + AI Coach
Professional writing accuracy is directly assessed in written tests and email communications during hiring.
🤖 AI Writing Coach — Get Instant Feedback
Write anything — an email, a project update, a status report, or a Q&A answer — and get AI feedback on grammar, vocabulary, professional register, and structure.
✍️ Daily Writing Habit — Q&A Answers
Write your answer · STAR check · Review with Grammarly · Refine
💡 Target: Write 2 Q&A answers per day in the Q&A tab. Use ⭐ STAR Check after each. Run through Grammarly. This builds both content and English accuracy simultaneously.
📝 Writing Lab — Professional Documents
LinkedIn summary · Cover letters · Professional emails · Executive summaries
💡 Target: Complete all 4 writing exercises in the Writing tab. Each one builds real documents you will use in the hiring process.
📧 Email Writing Practice
Professional structure · Formal register · Clear subject lines · Action-oriented
💡 Exercise: Write a follow-up email after an imaginary interview. Then write a project status email to an executive. Compare your structure to the model answers in the Writing tab.
Email Writing Guide →
🗣️ Speaking Practice + AI Coach
Speaking confidence is built through repetition, recording, and feedback — not through reading. Use these tools daily.
🤖 AI Speaking Coach — Practice & Get Feedback
Choose an interview question, type or paste your spoken answer as you would say it, then get AI feedback on structure, vocabulary, delivery language, and STAR compliance.
🗣️ Shadowing Tab — Daily Fluency Training
Your personalized scripts · Hear the model · Record yours · Compare
💡 Target: 2 shadowing sentences per day. Listen → repeat immediately → record → play back → note the gap. Do this until the gap disappears.
🎙️ Mock Interview — Timed Speaking
Real interview pressure · Timed responses · Self-assessment
💡 Target: 3 mock interviews per week in the Mock tab. Score yourself on: answer structure, vocabulary range, grammatical accuracy, and confidence. Track improvement.
🤖 ChatGPT — Speaking Practice Partner
Unlimited conversation · Grammar feedback · Vocabulary suggestions · Available 24/7
💡 Prompt to use: "Act as a Gulf PMO Director interviewer. Ask me Q&A interview questions one at a time. After each answer, give me feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and structure. Be specific."
Open ChatGPT →
📹 Record Yourself — Weekly Video Review
Phone camera · 2-minute answers · Weekly comparison
💡 Exercise: Every Sunday, record yourself answering Q1 (Tell me about yourself) on video. Watch it back. Rate: pace, filler words, eye contact, grammatical errors. Compare to last week.
Most valuable English improvement tool — nothing shows you your gaps faster than watching yourself speak.
